nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Polls the business inbox every minute: new mail Gmail files under Primary (order notices, promotions and updates are skipped)

nodes.name: email filter
nodes.notes: This environment's mail only; skips robots, auto-replies and bulk mail; keeps only the new text

nodes.name: to intake
nodes.notes: Same webhook as a form post: everything after this is the normal intake

parameters.content:
## Enquiry Desk — email channel

A new email in the business inbox becomes a normal enquiry: this workflow only **converts** it and posts it to the intake webhook (`channel: email` plus Gmail's message and thread ids).

The intake does the rest. Its reply draft joins the customer's Gmail thread only after `thread check` confirms the sender with Gmail.

STAGING takes mail sent to `<mailbox>+staging@…`; production takes the rest.
